# Intuit CFO Sandeep Aujla to Present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference


November 24, 2026 4:00pm EST[Download as PDF](https://investors.intuit.com/_assets/_7623f1ff5267b6890da8feeaf8f86c55/intuit/news/2026-11-24_Intuit_CFO_Sandeep_Aujla_to_Present_at_the_UBS_1332.pdf)


MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Intuit Inc. (Nasdaq: INTU), the global financial technology platform that makes[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) , and[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite/) , announced today that Sandeep Aujla, chief financial officer, will present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference on Tuesday, Dec. 1, in Scottsdale, AZ.


The fireside chat will begin at 11:15 a.m. Pacific Time and will be available live via audio webcast at[https://investors.intuit.com/news-events](https://investors.intuit.com/news-events) . A replay of the webcast will be available on Intuit’s Investor Relations website after the presentation ends.


**About Intuit**


[Intuit](http://intuit.com/) is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the consumers, businesses, and accountants we serve, with products including[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) , and[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite) . Intuit's financial intelligence brings together decades of trusted data, deep financial expertise, AI, and human experts to help customers at every stage of their financial journey. This puts more money in their pockets, saves time by reducing manual work, and ensures they have complete confidence in every financial decision. For more information, visit[Intuit.com](http://intuit.com/) .
